normal.text: Wait cozy games aren’t for boys?

normal.name: Brian Warren
normal.text: Submitted a new app to the App Store. This one's a cozy little word game. Looking forward to sharing this one with you all.

normal.name: Jen Allaway Writes Games With Big Hearts
normal.text: Husband and I are co-oping GTA VI. I don't know what all the hubbub is about murder and crime in the game is, all I've done is swim with fishies, find artifacts, bird watch, and pamper my wife?? GTA VI is the cozy game of the year.

normal.name: Runolllo
normal.text: I think I might be too stupid to play creative games or maybe it's ADHD??? Or maybe Pokopia just makes inventory management impossible. In other such games I play (say Stardew, Mistria, Starbound, Core Keeper) I get overwhelmed too with so many items but never to the absurd level as in Pokopia...

normal.name: Windows97 Tech Support
normal.text: Minesweeper was the epitome of computer games. Good. Wholesome. Never once did it let hackers steal your credit card number and mother’s maiden name. Did I mention it was completely free? That was just a gift, to you, from Microsoft

normal.name: Oliver 🐣
normal.text: Cozy games are lovely, but does your shelf ever need a nap after a long crafting session with Tremola the Tamagotchi?

normal.name: Tyrone
normal.text: Finishing chapter 1 of GTA and what the hell happened to my cozy game?

normal.name: Garlax, The Weasel King
normal.text: I wonder what the overlap is there though? I've seen people who treat (and mod) Skyrim as a cozy game- maybe these current weirdos are more like the asshats who whined about Skyrim not letting you kill kids.

normal.name: Sapient PC-98 Tapedeck (Cosette)
normal.text: This is true but that's kinda why I'm enthralled by it It's essentially an elevated, over the top life sim with a really robust crime system bolted to the side & that's kinda awesome in a weird way?? (Sidenote: I have not bought it & will not until it's on PC & on sale)

normal.name: Rylee, Girl of the Future
normal.text: GTA6 is truly a wild game. I don't know if I'm ever going to feel like I'm ever doing more than just scratching the surface? It feels like every time I turn around I find something new to do. The life sim aspects are incredibly addicting to me. I haven't even stolen a car yet

normal.name: Smaxx
normal.text: Bought it, but have yet to find time, so I gave the whole bundle a nice cozy place on top my pile of shame. *pats the game list entry* 😉 Btw. is it intentional the bundles are no longer visible (at least for me with a German IP)? I could still buy the Complete Bundle through a link, though.
